[SWS_Rte_72021]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00306, SRS_Rte_00300, SRS_Rte_00303, SRS_Rte_00179
⌈The associated Cross Software Cluster Communication Plug-In shall
provide the Rte_Rips_DataIsUpdated Service for each VariableDataProto-
type in an AbstractRequiredPortPrototype for which a VariableAccess of
a RunnableEntity in the role dataReceivePointByValue or dataReceive-
PointByArgument exists, if
• for the related Data Communication Graph the Cross Software Clus-
ter Communication Plug-In support is enabled
AND
• the enableUpdate attribute is enabled in the NonqueuedReceiverComSpec
of the VariableDataPrototype.
⌋
[SWS_Rte_82015]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00306, SRS_Rte_00300, SRS_Rte_00303
⌈The RTE shall call Rte_Rips_DataIsUpdated at the position and instead of the
RTE’s regular API to access the update flag for an explicit receiver, if for the related
Data Communication Graph the Cross Software Cluster Communication
Plug-In support is enabled.⌋
The return value of the Rte_Rips_DataIsUpdated is used to indicate status of data
detected by the RTE Implementation Plug-In during by the communication sys-
tem.
